notes.title: Dual Cat: Max Will Be Released on Desktop and Steam Deck
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I'm excited to announce that [b]Dual Cat: Max[/b] will be released on Steam later this year. The game will be available on [b]Windows [/b]and[b] Steam Deck[/b].

[b]Dual Cat: Max[/b] is a puzzle-platformer about a cute cat named [b]Max [/b]and his friend [b]Erwin[/b]. They were kidnapped by robots for experimentation. Help them outsmart their enemies and find their way back home, where their favorite treats and games await.

Check out the gameplay trailer below!

[previewyoutube=ebWQLPnaKW0;full][/previewyoutube]

A demo version featuring 10 levels is available now. Don't forget to add the game to your [b]wishlist[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3147720/Dual_Cat_Max/


We’re also honored to be part of the Ukrainian Games Festival 2024. Visit this event to check out hundreds of titles made by Ukrainian developers!
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/UkrainianGames2024
